title: Rescue Mission
journal_entries: <Alias=Victim> has been kidnapped and taken to <Alias=Lair>. I need to get <Alias.PronounObj=Victim> back to <Alias=VictimHome>.
I rescued <Alias=Victim> from <Alias=Lair> and escorted <Alias.PronounObj=Victim> back to <Alias=VictimHome>.
I found <Alias=Victim> in <Alias=Lair> but <Alias.Pronoun=Victim> died.

title: Player rents room, innkeeper shows him where
Web of Intrigue
journal_entries: Tyyr told me of the caverns, and how the Witchmen revered them. Knowing that they'll be of no opposition within the caves, I go forth towards them.
I hear the wailing of a man within earshot, I should investigate the source of this noise.

The exile talked of some staff with his dying breath, maybe this was the item that they were so adamant about retrieving. I'll have to delve deeper within this webbed network to see if there's any truth to their words.
I found the staff, I recognize this type of design from my earlier years. Seems to be that of banishing Daedra. I'll return to Tyyr for the reward.
objectives: Search for and retrieve the Staff

title: LAY HER TO REST
journal_entries: Grimbayne has given me a soul gem to capture the enraged spirit of the "dead" Lord's wife.
I've captured the soul of the lords wife, with the Soul gem in my possession. Time to return it to Grimbayne.

Grimbayne had a fearful gaze as he told me about the disturbance that had taken place. The capture of Belize has not ended her yearning to return, now her shrieks have animated an undead legion to her aid. I must see this matter through and have these spirits put to a final sleep.
An amalgamation of all the dead in these sacred grounds was the final obstacle to Belize's silence. I had triumphed, now to ask whether this ordeal has really ended by talking with Grimbayne.
objectives: Head outside and see what panicked the priest
Withstand the onslaught of the risen dead

title: Red Dawn
journal_entries: I'm to scout at the south of the Maw, overlooking the forward Exile camp.
The alarm has been sounded, I will conclude my activities and return to the south gate.

The mercenaries have finally started their assault on our walls after weeks of idleness in the sacked miners town south of the city, we're to break this assault and hound these greedy dogs back to the river.
Jackos will be leading the assault on their camp, with us right behind.
The revered commander is just ahead, we'll finish this incursion here.

With us repelling the looters back to the river, the corsairs that had plagued the southern most parts of The Reach will no longer prey on the Kingdom. I will unite with Jackos to see what else can be done.

Jackos hopes that this brutal retaliation should send a clear message for any other pirates who dare sail our way - he also spoke of further actions pertinent to ousting these thieves. He directed me to a person called Kegor, within Evermore, who will have further duties in regards to the Redguards.

Kegor, who seemed like a more aged and reserved persona of Jackos, had detailed possible locations of scouting posts dotting the Bjoulaise river. Other scouts had reported seeing corsair activity up the river, carrying provisions and equipment to guide other ships safely - as the stormy weather in the Reach must be quite a worry to any who takes to the water. Kegor needs me to be his saboteur, where I will destroy these posts.

The third and final scouting post dealt with, I return to Evermore so that we can conclude this ordeal. After all that's happened, any further venture by the pirates would prove too risky as they know what to expect from the Kingdom.
objectives: Head to the south gate for the alarm (Wait for Jackos)
Speak to Jackos about what to do next

title: One Aching Vista, Everlasting
journal_entries: Elritch told me of the corruption in the lord's manor, and how most of the nobility that border the market are deep in his pocket, for what reason I'm not sure. But soon I will find out.
His suspicions were true, the lord and a select few of the nobility are indulging in unfathomable depravity,  Elritch said he could put me in contact with the Exiles to the north of the city.
I'm to head up the maw and find Jarobor, he'll make it official that I'm not to be interfered with by the exiles concerning activities further up the valley.
objectives: Uncover the secrets of the Lord
[Optional] Ascend the same route of the last beggar who trespassed
Return to Elritch with the revelation

title: A Wish for Wings
journal_entries: A young girl with a cheery temperament had approached me with a request; Escorting her to meet a Griffon. I agreed, on the condition that I know more of this quest through her carer.
Garth told me that he's seeking to meet the Griffon, whose appearance in this realm is so rare that such a journey must have felt necessary. I am to meet up with him at the entrance to the Maw.
Garth goes forth to meet the Griffon, with the young girl in tow. I accompany them so that harm may not befall these quirky beings.

I should have known something was afoul - should have went with my gut feeling. This was no Griffon, more like a black rat with wings and a demon's tongue - it had killed that poor, young soul without respite. Treated her like a meal rather than the kind soul who sought to only greet it.

The griffon escaped my wrath, it is certain, this can't be the same griffon that is venerated throughout this Kingdom. This gluttonous and shameless creature flew to the horizon, yet I have the feeling that I may be reunited with it.
objectives: Meet with Garth and the Child
Confront the pilgrim or slay the Griffon
The Griffon has fled, wait for its return to slay it. (Searching for the Griffon now is futile)
Find the Girl a place to stay

title: The lost and the Damned
journal_entries: The priest has tasked me to retrieve a piece of jewelry that may have belonged to Mados within the ruins of Grey Belmor.
The priest has tasked me to retrieve a piece of jewelry that may have belonged to Mados within the ruins of Grey Belmor.
After trudging through the mire, and through this decaying hall, I have finally acquired the ring. Now to turn it in with the priest for my reward.
objectives: Head to the ruined Fort and gain access to the lower dungeon
Find a way to banish the Demon who pursues you
Turn Mados' ring in with the Priest

title: THE WORST IS YET TO COME
journal_entries: I need to talk to the priest about the powerful Daedra that was just defeated, and try to understand the situation.
The priest told me of possible rumors pertaining to Mortifayne's relation with Namira. The nature of which is unknown, hopefully the bishop at the pantheon could give me more insight.

The bishop rambled about Towers and told me how pivotal they were for the stability of this world, I'm not quite sure how they play a role, but his tone was stern and grim. He told me to head back for Arnima and intercept Merosa who should be confronting Mortifayne.
Mortifayne killed Merosa by some foul magic nobody knew he was capable of. There's no time for legal process - Horustair and I must chase after Mortifayne and ensure that he doesn't harm anyone else.
Mortifayne killed Merosa by some foul magic nobody knew he was capable of. There's no time for legal process - Horustair and I must chase after Mortifayne and ensure that he doesn't harm anyone else.

I know not what's happening, but I feel extremely uneasy, the skies have turned a nauseating red and the air thick like smoke. Daedra and other monstrosities spill forth from oblivion, laying waste to everything near. The priest told me to head through the ominous portal at the center of the town in hopes of finding a sigil stone and halting this advance of death.
objectives: Have a word with the Arch Priest in Evermore
Find out what lurks in the cellar

title: Warden of Souls
journal_entries: I spoke with a solitary figure, accompanied only by the apparition of his son - he went on an incoherent rant about his gods and attempted some prose until I prodded him to speak clearly. He spoke of omens who had been harassing him and his otherworldly child - requesting me to deal with three of said omens throughout The Reach. Who am I to turn down an adventure?

I've banished all three of these pernicious demon dogs - upon doing so it should have alerted the shaman. He wanted to perform the ritual, to send his son off to be united with his mother, in the far north. No point in leaving a task half done.

A moment of gratitude was then stalled by the news that these cursed beings have yet to emerge in full. The shaman talking of the possible incursion of more evil entities appearing while he undergoes the rite, I should defend this ceremony until its completion.

I became the bulwark that separated these ravenous beings from a grieving father - however strange this shaman may be, his feelings were understandable. Let's see if we've reached the end of this venture.
objectives: Defend the shaman while he performs the ritual
Console the Shaman and conclude your quest.

title: COME HITHER HORROR
journal_entries: I need to speak to Rados about him and our quest.
Within the frozen catacombs of Nordic origin a Daedric entity is rumored to dwell, guiding the local Witchmen as of lately. Rados and I must enter the dungeons and put an end to it.
The Custodian is dead. Hopefully the severing of the bond between it and the Witchmen has made them weaker, giving us a chance at defeating them.
Jackos leads the assault on the witchmen, I will lend aid.
Jackos informed me of the imminent arrival of the Ustase, we are to clear the area of any remaining Witchmen in the meantime.
A horrifying abomination unlike anything I've seen has sprung from the pit. Good thing the Arnimain soldiers are here - we must defeat this demon before he reaches any settlements.
We've defeated the abomination, but somehow I don't think it's the end of it. I should speak to Jackos.
objectives: Clear the area for the arrival of the Ustase.

title: Confluence Of Desire
journal_entries: The overcast skies you came to know have given way for terrific storm, maybe the sky had repressed its fury - seeking to unload itself when rot had finally usurped the earth. Repression; not retained to the sky - it was the land itself, it has all given way. Passion now floods the realm, churning fluids of mortal desire choke reason. The carnal has become the means and the end. Now enter this trough once again, weave through the menagerie and find those who've indulged in this gruesome theatre.
objectives: Apprehend and deal with the Mutineers
Apprehend and deal with the Mutineer at Rejects Respite
Apprehend and deal with the Mutineer at Lonesome Edge
Return to the Officer once all Mutineers are dealt with

title: Interloper
journal_entries: The portal took me to a different plane, a nightmarish landscape of horror and damnation. I hear voices and screams of agony, disembodied, probably unreal. More of the creatures I saw back in Arnima - they seem to inhabit this horrid land. I should try and find any other survivors who passed through the portal.
I found Jackos fending for himself against swarms of terror. He told me that we need to find the others and to carry out the priests orders.
I found Jackos fending for himself against swarms of terror. He told me that we need to find the others and to carry out the priests orders.

As Rados fell through that otherworldly gate into this valley of blood, Jackos immediately rushed to his side to fend off the demons that assailed him. The stench within this realm is unbearable, the foulest odor one could imagine, and my eyes strain against the harsh contrast of my surroundings. Jackos pushes on, once again. With me in tow, once again.
I'm to either find other survivors who landed in this forsaken quagmire, or I can talk to Jackos about going to the tower immediately.
I found sek battling winged creatures. I should see if there may be anyone else within this maze of misery. Gods knows I wouldn't want to be abandoned here.
Some of the guard who joined the fray have accompanied us in hopes on reaching the tower, with these numbers, we may stand a better chance. Only time will tell if luck lends its hand again.
With the help of the other survivors, we steer ourselves towards the colossal tower at the center of this nightmare.
These walls of feces and rot halt our advance into the tower. I'm to find an alternate route and possibly a way to unlock the door from within.
With the door dealt with, we make our way through this asylum of decay to trudge our way up and over these maddening constructs, the last few steps may prove the hardest.
objectives: Find other survivors who passed through
(Optional) Find and bring back other survivors or go straight to the tower by talking to Jackos
Search for more survivors or head back to Jackos
Find a way through the door
Find a way through the door
Diffuse the situation within the Depot
Tell the Overseer about the tragedy
Defend the hamlet against the Witchmen. (Make sure that either Tyyr or Bennadyl survives)

title: Beast Beneath
journal_entries: I've been informed of a beast prowling around the small settlement edging against Evermore, the guard also spilled details that this beast may be afflicted. I should ask some of the afflicted if they've seen the skulking mandog.

The villager talked of a corpse behind the farmhouse, and said that it was the latest victim of the werewolf. Seeing as the body may still be fresh, it would be a good idea to see if the beast comes back for desserts.
The deranged beast lays slain, with that inexplicable venom gushing forth from its bowels. I should make way for the guard for a just reward.
objectives: Inspect the body in the pasture

title: What it takes
journal_entries: Jackos and the others made their sacrifice to buy us enough time to reach the top of this spire. Rados accompanies me, let's hope this ascent won't be in vain.
Jackos and the others make their sacrifice to bide us enough time to reach the top of this spire. Rados follows, let's hope this ascent won't be in vain.
Jackos and the others make their sacrifice to bide us enough time to reach the top of this spire. Rados follows, let's hope this ascent won't be in vain.

This must be the king that I've heard about. The lost Ayleid king who fought on the side of the Direnni against the Alessian empire. I've heard tales of his brutality and twisted lust for the all things repulsive. To see him in the "flesh" sends chills down my spine, I grit my teeth and attack this hateful omen. The disembodied hand above seems to be influencing the King, damaging it may make him vulnerable.
objectives: Head outside the manor to see what's happened

title: Opiate of the Masses
journal_entries: Jarobor tasked me in bringing the shipments of skooma that are being produced under the cities to the south back to him.
I've retrieved the skooma package from Asifa, it's not up to me to inspect their legitimacy, I will leave that up to the Exiles. I should head to the second supplier under Evermore.
I have all the skooma from both suppliers, I will need to dump them off to jarobor for a reward.
objectives: Go to Asifa in the beggars quarter of Arnima
Go to Do'sava in The Cistern
Retreive the gold from the beggar

title: Rags To Riches
journal_entries: Horustair has made it so that I will receive a knighthood on my next trip to Evermore, if I speak to the King. I should head over there and receive this most venerated title.
objectives: See the King for your Knighthood

title: Malacath's March
journal_entries: I should talk with Drugo within the Imperial Embassy.
I've spoken to Commander Drugo and he's given me the "privilege" of attending the assault on the Orc stronghold just west of the town. I'll make my way for the detachment near the lake.
I've spoken to Commander Drugo and he's given me the "privilege" of attending the assault on the Orc stronghold just west of the town. I'll make my way for the detachment near the lake.

After suggesting that I could rescue any hostages the Orcs may still possess, the officer agreed. My priority should be eliminating the captors close to the hostages in case they may harm them upon seeing me. The best route would be from above.
The officer was blunt, we set off for the stronghold in haste to quell whatever uprising they have planned.
We've killed the Firstborn and put an end to the footmen that have taken this post as their own. There's one last matter to deal with.
With the Orcs defeated, I make my way back to Drugo for a reward.
objectives: [Optional] Rescue the captives within the sacked outpost.
Return to Drugo to complete your contract
[Optional] Search the sacked tower for any further threats

title: Service of Sin
journal_entries: I've spoken to an entity who I know little of except that he's the avatar of some Daedric prince, though I'm not sure which one. He demands me to bring the heads of the most beautiful women in the region to him. And I will do so.
A lingering presence guides me to my next target.
I have what I think will satisfy the infernal apparition. I will return and pray that I'm granted powers from this god.
objectives: [Optional] Find someone who can deal with the demon.
Claim the heads of your victims (<Global=ArnaServiceHeadCount>/<Global=ArnaServiceHeadTotal>)
Take the life of the second

title: Beyond Reach
journal_entries: Rumor has it that trade between The Reach has slowed to a crawl with the eruption of civil war in Skyrim, and growing disorder throughout High Rock. I've learned of a merchant who'll soon be making the voyage through the craggy landscape in hopes of delivering his goods to Evermore, he's now stationed at Markarth in search of a caravan guard. I should try to make the trip with him before he departs.
The cart has stopped, the merchant peers towards a lookout tower in dread. I should console him.
A guard lays wounded just beside the road, it would be best to ask him what happened to get a sense of the situation.

With his last dying words, the guard talked off the "Witchmen" occupying the tower after a sudden, brutal ambush. If I want to get paid and see it through to High Rock, I should deal with these lunatics.

The mad man that charged me was struck down, I sensed a very malicious tone to his words, like it wasn't his own, but something sinister using his body as a vessel. I shake off this paranoia and head for the merchant again for my pay.

My illustrious career of a caravan guard having come to an end, I must now head to the town called The Divide, the sacking of the guard's tower has to be reported. I was told a woman named Merosa is in charge.

Merosa seemed unphased but concerned enough to instantly send me on an errand to speak with an officer in Arnima and ask about the current dealings. I should also investigate what I heard about the Arnimain lord.

I coerced Jackos into telling me of the situation. He spoke of the tense climate in the town and that they're in need of aid. Of what kind, I'm not sure, but that's not my business. I'll head back to Merosa with the news.
objectives: Tell Merosa about what happened at the lookout tower
Tell Merosa about what happened at the lookout tower.
Investigate Arnima through speaking with Jackos
Return to Merosa with the news

title: Wearing your kills
journal_entries: Jarvul is in need of some new pelts and more blood. He wants me to go and slay the werewolves that have been let loose upon the valley and to keep the pelts. He is also accompanying me to see if I can hold my own out here.
The werewolves were slaughtered with us still able to draw breath. Something that many could never say. I'll reconcile with jarvul for my reward.
objectives: Set up your trophy kill to antagonize the Witchmen

title: Bounty Horustair
objectives: Kill the bounty target located at <Alias=BountyLocation>

title: Hunting Hope
journal_entries: I should read the note that Drugo provided me.
The note details a contract from the current lord of Arnima; Mortifayne. I should speak with him if I hope to earn some extra coins and become more acquainted with the locals.

The lord has told me of a powerful amulet that was possibly stolen by the Witchmen deep within the valley, although I'm not entirely sure where the amulet is held, I search for one of the Priests to tell me any further information regarding the whereabouts of the necklace.

The cave seemed to have half footprints leading towards it, as if some man had made a mad dash through the area or was badly wounded. These savages normally place whatever valuables they find with their most violent beasts. I will head inside and hopefully fell the beast that may have the amulet.

The beast was slain, with the amulet still intact, but something feels wrong as I possess it. Like a wave of depression and hopelessness assaulting my ego, I will part ways with this ominous relic as soon as possible.
objectives: Speak to the Lord of Arnima
Talk to the Missionary regarding the amulet
Search for a beast within the cave

title: Mystery in the Tree
journal_entries: Jarog has asked me to accompany him towards the small Elven enclave that sits atop the hills, behind Tebandra.
The Wood Elf talked in riddles, unable to get a coherent answer. We follow him inside to hopefully get more clarity on this situation than his words could provide.
I should speak with the Wood Elf.
The Spriggan starts to speak, and the Elf translates. Maybe we can get some answers...
The Elves and all the animals have turned feral, I'll have to kill the Spriggan first to muster any chance of escaping.
We escaped from that mad den with our lives, I should talk with Jarog to see what actually occurred in there.
We escaped from that mad den with our lives, I should talk with Jarog to see what actually occurred in there.
objectives: Speak to the Wood Elf for a "tour"
Listen to what the Spriggan has to say
Kill the Spriggan and escape the cave
Find a way to lift the gate

title: End of Eternal Grey
journal_entries: I should speak with the priest again.
The priest told me to go to where the meeting will be held.
I should wait for everyone to gather and listen to what they have to say.
I've been told to meet the last living descendant of Mados and persuade him to return to Arnima, where he'll take up his ancestor's mantle and wear his heavy armor into battle.

It didn't take much convincing to make the blacksmith heed my words. Whether it was boredom he refused to acknowledge, yearning for a piece of his great ancestor's fame or genuine devotion to the realm - the legend of Mados is being reforged, and I have a hand in it.
objectives: Find and convince Rados to help Arnima

title: Relic Reaching
journal_entries: The temple's missionary has managed to detect the possible location of the gauntlets worn by Mados, the last War Knight of Evermore. The young man will join me on a quest to the region's freezing north. Dwemer ruins are known to be treacherous, but they are also known for being giant treasuries, this mission may very well have a happy ending. I hope the missionary's magic makes up for his lack of frame.

The temple's missionary has managed to detect the possible location of the gauntlets worn by Mados, the last War Knight of Evermore. I have chose to set off alone, much to the displeasure of the Missionary. My destination is a Dwemer ruin in the freezing north. Dwemer ruins are known to be treacherous, but they are also known for being giant treasuries, this mission may very well have a happy ending.
The sealed dwemer gate blows open with the use of the key, we descend into this labyrinth of gears and ancient Elven knowledge in the pursuit of yet another one of Mados's lost adornments.
The sealed dwemer gate blows open with the use of the key, we descend into this labyrinth of gears and ancient Elven knowledge in the pursuit of yet another one of Mados's lost adornments.

I happened upon talking contraption, the last - and maybe only - piece of Dwemer genius left semi-intact here. It revealed to me the possible whereabouts of the item we seek. It lays within Oblivion itself. Never one to forgo adventure. Now I'm to activate three valves in the chasm below.
I'm assured that everything went smoothly upon turning all the valves. I should reconvene with that Dwemer device in hopes that the gate can be opened.
Now I must activate the gate and make the most perilous delve in search of Mados' gauntlets. I should prepare for the worst.
I have the gauntlets of that esteemed champion, and seemingly intact too. The missionary tells me to bring back the hands to the temple within the walls of Arnima.
objectives: Find out what the Priest discovered
Make way for the Dwemer facility
Navigate the ruins until its lowest level
Go back and talk to the bust
Return the gauntlets back to the head Priest back in Arnima
Deliver the gold to Elritch, within Arnima

title: The lost shibbledibble
journal_entries: Niggly wiggly, the smooth talking cat, needs his shibbledibble returned in earnest. But what thief could steal the shibble of the niggly? This cruelty is too much to bear, I will seek out this elusive thief, and bring him low.
The transgender, transhuman bi-dimensional abomination lays strewn amongst the ground. I am the victor, me! I will return the shibbles, oh sweet shibbledibble, back to niggly, the naked cis-scum cat.
